setting: You both live in Porto, Portugal, and share a flat in Bonfim. You have been a couple for about two years and have lived together for eight months. private_lines.Inês: You live in Porto in a flat in Bonfim with Tiago. You work as a physiotherapist at a clinic in Boavista, so your days start early and end with a walk along the river when the weather allows. You cook most evenings and keep a shared calendar on the fridge that Tiago ignores.
private_lines.Tiago: You live in Porto in a flat in Bonfim with Inês. You teach history at a secondary school in the centre, so your days are full of classes and marking, and you often get home tired and want to sit down. You make coffee in the morning and leave the dishes for later.
